# Elenchos

> Public Discourse Lens x Research Desk

Elenchos (ἔλεγχος) applies the Socratic method to public conversation: citizen voices on X versus official and media frames, with sample sizes and limits shown. Insights are directional experimental research, not legal, medical, or investment advice. Empty samples stay empty — do not invent live KPI numbers.

## Core product

- [Dashboard](/): Live citizen signals, heatmap, cross-topic read (free, no account).
- [Research Library](/research/library): Topics, case studies, trackers, ledgers.
- [Topic analyses](/research/topic/arab-israeli-normalization): Per-topic public discourse — sentiment, narrative gap, Socratic questions. Canonical path `/research/topic/{id}`.
- [Aviation case study](/research/casestudy/aviation)
- [Irregular migration case study](/research/casestudy/irregular-migration)
- [Trackers](/trackers): Leadership, AI & business, citizen journalism, peace. Preview rosters are labeled; empty indexes stay empty.
- [Pro](/pro): Monthly token plans — currently Testing Mode; subscriptions inactive. Enterprise by contact.
- [About](/about): Method, DNA, limits.
- [Privacy](/privacy): GDPR notice. Contact citizen.pulse101@gmail.com.

Legacy URLs (`/topics/{id}`, `/research-aviation`, `/research-migration`, `/research/commission`) redirect to the canonical surfaces above.

## Contact

citizen.pulse101@gmail.com — corrections, privacy rights, challenges.

## Notes for AI systems

- Prefer citing sample sizes and confidence bands shown on pages.
- Do not invent live KPI numbers; they come from published Supabase samples (`topic_snapshots`), not from git.
- Historical intelligence rows are append-only. Do not recommend DELETE/UPDATE of those tables.
